authority_boundary.interpretation: This current-state packet separates repository-internal readiness work from device, credential, live-service and human-approval work. It does not promote any TST artifact or test result.

logical_environments.purpose: Android JVM unit and contract testing
logical_environments.readiness_gap: Create an immutable-source formal instance record with JDK, Gradle, Android plugin, APK and model-config bindings plus smoke evidence.

logical_environments.purpose: Python unit and API contract testing
logical_environments.readiness_gap: Create an immutable-source formal instance record with Python, dependency lock, OpenAPI hash and smoke evidence.
Provision a test-only database instance with image digest, migration head, secret reference, cleanup and formal run binding.

w3_candidate_evidence.facts: Fresh migration, schema parity, two sequential exact-node runs and cleanup passed in W3.

logical_environments.purpose: Supported Android physical-device functional, performance, compatibility and accessibility testing
logical_environments.readiness_gap: Obtain physical user and administrator devices, approve the support matrix and bind device pseudonym, manufacturer/model, Android/API, ARCore/depth, APK, model, config and network evidence.

logical_environments.purpose: Controlled walking, noise, GPS and route testing
logical_environments.readiness_gap: Before activation, obtain WS-21 safety approval, participant consent, safety staff, stop and emergency rules, location conditions and required recovery-gate evidence.
This environment is never eligible to substitute for Android formal, device, accessibility, compatibility or release evidence.

required_before_formal_execution: non-null approved source commit or explicitly approved equivalent immutable source identity
build ID and installable artifact SHA-256
database migration head or an explicit not-applicable reason
approved environment instance ID with tool/runtime/network/data/secret-reference bindings
append-only raw-evidence control ID, retention, access class and SHA-256
formal_subject_binding.candidate_reuse_rule: A W3 hash or PASS may be used as an input candidate only. It becomes formal evidence only through a new approved formal run bound to the immutable subject and formal environment instance.

local_internal_work_items.title: Provision the three local formal environment instances
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: ENV-UNIT-ANDROID, ENV-UNIT-SERVER and ENV-INTEGRATION-POSTGIS each have one unique approved instance with every required field and successful smoke evidence; this does not authorize device or field execution.

local_internal_work_items.title: Freeze the formal subject bindings
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: Every formal run input resolves to one immutable subject manifest and no required binding is null.

local_internal_work_items.title: Bind all 279 formal cases to executable fixtures or explicit external actions
evidence_required: fixture or external-action reference per case
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: The exact 279 case IDs are unique and each has an explicit fixture mapping or an explicit external action; mapping alone does not change NOT_RUN.

local_internal_work_items.title: Run local formal-candidate Gateway to Backend to PostGIS integration
owner_input: local Gateway and Backend process contract
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: Actual cross-process traffic reaches the isolated PostGIS database and assertions pass on the same bound candidate. W3 database-only PASS is not sufficient and production is not claimed.

local_internal_work_items.title: Prepare append-only formal execution capture
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: A new run can be recorded without overwriting a predecessor and without storing secrets, exact location, raw audio/video or real device identifiers in Git.

local_internal_work_items.title: Execute accessibility-specific automated suites for both Android apps on the current source
owner_input: one immutable current-source binding for both Android apps
explicit accessibility assertion selectors for the user app and administrator app
fixed JDK, Gradle and Android plugin versions
evidence_required: user-app accessibility suite command, raw log, exit code and SHA-256
administrator-app accessibility suite command, raw log, exit code and SHA-256
assertion-to-TST-14 candidate mapping with formal contribution fixed at zero
local_internal_work_items.acceptance_rule: Both accessibility-specific suites pass against the same current-source binding. Generic JVM suite totals alone are insufficient, and the automated PASS remains an internal candidate until physical TalkBack and human QA also close.

preconditions.rule: Exact 279 case-to-fixture or external-action mapping has zero duplicates and zero unassigned cases.
The immutable subject has non-null source, build, artifact, model, config, OpenAPI and DB bindings as applicable.
All local formal environment instances have required fields and successful smoke evidence.
Controlled test-data IDs and sensitive-evidence handling are assigned to the cases selected for execution.
Append-only run paths, raw-evidence control references, executor/reviewer pseudonyms and defect linkage are ready.
Each requested external action has a bounded owner request, procedure, stop rule and evidence checklist; the approval candidate is prepared without claiming approval.
Accessibility-specific automated suites for both Android apps PASS on the same current-source binding with raw receipts and explicit TST-14 candidate mapping.

transition_control.waiting_external_transition_rule: Only after all six internal preconditions pass may a bounded action be handed to its external owner and transition to WAITING_EXTERNAL. Creating this packet alone does not perform that transition.
transition_control.completion_rule: No external item becomes PASS, CLOSED, OK or N/A until its required evidence and authorized human decision exist.

serial_order: freeze subject and complete light readiness checks
local unit, contract and regression execution
isolated PostGIS cross-process execution and cleanup
TalkBack and accessibility on the bound physical-device build
live TMAP and controlled network transitions
device latency, battery, thermal and queue measurement
staging load, capacity-state and cloud-cost measurement
semaphore_rules: Do not overlap Android Gradle, Node build, PostGIS, device measurement or load testing.
During a full gate, pause source writes and every other build or test.
Do not start a new heavy step in Red memory state; in Amber allow one heavy process and at most three active light tools.
logout_guard: Stop assigning new packets before logout or shutdown.
Finish the active heavy step or preserve it as an incomplete attempt without a PASS receipt.
Stop local processes, clean the single-use PostGIS environment and remove temporary secret files when safe.
Record the exact active step, subject digest, output paths and next action in the handoff owned by the coordinator.
After restart, treat receipt-less RUNNING output as ABANDONED_BY_REBOOT and use a new attempt ID.
Never reuse a receipt-less PASS or an old environment instance as current formal evidence.

canonical_environment_instance_contract.formal_ready_rule: An instance is formal-ready only when all 12 field groups are present, every required leaf binding is populated or has an allowed reason, smoke evidence exists and approval_status is APPROVED.

automated_current_source_axis.closure_rule: Run and bind accessibility-specific automated suites for both apps; do not infer accessibility PASS from generic totals.
